items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, that last year Letharschi was '77. '73 did you go again -- [INTERVIEWEE] '74 I went again.

ctx.x: No, no, no. First time I ever done the Montreux Festival was last year, after we left out from Nice to go to do that, and we did the North Sea and Holland, yeah.
Well, that last year Letharschi was '77. '73 did you go again --
